Contributor’s Guide

OpenBQ is an open-source biometric quality framework developed and maintained by Biometix Pty Ltd. We welcome contributions from developers, testers, researchers and documentation writers.

Where to start?

  • Read the Getting Started guide to install and run OpenBQ.
  • Browse the repositories in the OpenBQ GitHub organisation.
  • Create a GitHub account if you don’t have one.
  • Read our Code of Conduct.

Areas of contribution

Code

  • Fix bugs and implement new features
  • Add or improve quality metrics and modality support
  • Improve performance and integrations

Testing

  • Test OpenBQ on different datasets, platforms and environments
  • Report bugs with clear steps to reproduce

Documentation

  • Improve guides, tutorials and the cookbook
  • Fix errors and fill gaps in these docs

Research and design

  • Share feedback on quality measures and standards alignment
  • Propose enhancements through GitHub Issues

Ready to fix an issue?

Follow the GitHub Workflow to fork, branch, sign off your commits and raise a pull request.

Found an issue or have an enhancement request?

Open an issue in the relevant repository, following the Issue Reporting Guidelines.

Licence

OpenBQ is licensed under the Apache License 2.0. By contributing, you agree that your contributions are licensed under the same licence. Full guidelines are in CONTRIBUTING.md.

Getting in touch

For questions, open a GitHub Issue or Discussion, or contact [CONTACT EMAIL].
